name: NewFi StakedV3 Invest rebalance at manipulated pool price
summary: StakedV3.Invest is public and, when the vault's PancakeSwap V3 farm position is out of range, withdraws it, swaps the proceeds with a minimum output quoted from the same pool's current price, and re-mints at the current tick. The attacker pushed the BUSD/USDT pool out of range with flash-loaned BUSD, called Invest with 1 BUSD so the vault sold about 36,100 BUSD for 1,627 USDT, and swapped back.
notes: The reset is the owner's poolCreat for pool id 2 (the BUSD/USDT 0.01% pool and farm Invest rebalanced), a market listing made 216 blocks after deployment; the later poolControl weight edit only sizes the swap.
Loss is the net BUSD depletion of the vault and the V3 pool holding its position, which nets the position's withdrawal and re-mint; USDT nets to zero and the 2.33 CAKE farm harvest is not subtracted.
No earlier exploit: every earlier Invest call since pool creation was sent directly by an EOA, so none moved the pool price within its transaction; campaign.mjs found no call after the anchor.
